May 16, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
Tiedemann Wealth Management Llc increased its stake in Nordstrom Inc (JWN) by 465.93% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tiedemann Wealth Management Llc bought 49,389 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.36% with the market. The institutional investor held 59,989 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.84 million, up from 10,600 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tiedemann Wealth Management Llc who had been investing in Nordstrom Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $8.40B market cap company. The stock increased 0.40% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $50.06. About 594,303 shares traded. Nordstrom, Inc. (NYSE:JWN) has risen 11.56% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.01% the S&P500.
